summary: Iteration 2 full backend + frontend testing of AURA with new Seat Picker (movie) and PDF Download. All 11 pytest cases pass (chat/search/confirm/book/seats persistence/prefixes/validation). Frontend E2E passes: seat picker renders only for movie above confirmation card, booked seats cannot be selected, selected-seats-text updates correctly, confirm is blocked when seat count != quantity (toast), confirming with 2 seats creates AURA-MOV-* booking with 'Seats' label visible in receipt, hotel/flight flows do NOT render seat picker and still produce AURA-HOT-/AURA-FLT- bookings. PDF download triggers a 'AURA-MOV-XXXXX.pdf' browser download using jsPDF (no network error).
critical_code_review_comments: pdf.js saves as `${booking_id}.pdf` which happens to start with 'AURA-' as the booking_id does — matches the request. OK.
SeatPicker.hashedBooked uses deterministic hash per option.id — good for repeatability; cosmetic: Math.abs on signed 32-bit overflow can collide, but acceptable for demo.
AuraApp.handleConfirm correctly blocks booking when selectedSeats.length !== quantity with toast; seats passed only when intent==='movie'. Good.
Backend BookRequest.seats is Optional[List[str]] stored into booking.extra.seats only for movie — verified via GET /api/booking/{id}.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ bookings via /api/book during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_aura_api.py (pytest). Seat picker testids: seat-picker, seat-{A1..H10}, selected-seats-text, seat-back-btn. Receipt testids: booking-receipt, booking-id, download-ticket-btn, new-booking-btn. PDF filename equals `${booking_id}.pdf`.
